== Japanese printing source review ==
Original Japanese title, lore, game text, subtype, destiny, title marks and icons were read from [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Dark-Maneuvers-PSA-20261106.jpg|the original photograph]]. Rarity is from the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Japanese checklist, p.97. English reading aids were prepared by ChatGPT against this photograph and [[:File:Premiere-D-darkmaneuvers.gif|the English printed face]]. The Japanese and English preserve the same maneuver, power and conditional hyperspeed increases through the remainder of the turn. The Japanese parenthesis refers generally to a destiny targeting the starfighter; the English specifically says a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver. The Japanese lore describes self-sacrificing tactics, while the English calls the tactics sophisticated. No Credits field is printed.
